examples.en: It was the first movie to feature onscreen product placement for its own merchandise.
examples.zh: 这是第一部为自己的商品做银幕植入式广告的电影。

examples.en: Seven is unique in one detail of its construction; it brings the killer onscreen with half an hour to go and gives him a speaking role.
examples.zh: 《七宗罪》在其结构的一个细节上是独特的；它在结束前半个小时才把杀手带到荧屏上，并给了他一个富有深意的角色。

examples.en: Timely Order Processing requirement description onscreen.
examples.zh: 及时订单处理需求描述接口。
